detail.longDescription: A 217 year old Napoleonic cipher has been cracked with GPT-6 Astra. Starting from a single scanned plate and only 33 previously known symbol values, the workflow combined image transcription, cryptanalysis, historical sources and computational verification to reconstruct a 1,300 unit cipher with 155 signs. A striking example of how AI can turn previously uneconomical research problems into feasible # DigitalHumanities projects. # AIResearch # ComputationalHistory https:// carter.church/writeups/the-let ter-to-marmont/
